answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the zenith is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the wharf of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vertex re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
